name: Provider latency (real calls)
description: Sends three short synthetic messages to the AI provider Archivist is configured with, through a local proxy that allows at most 6 requests and 64 output tokens each, and records time to first byte, first token and the whole reply. Opt-in only: it costs a little money and sends synthetic text to the provider.
initialConditions: Fresh disposable profile, 1280x840 window. Fixture: seed 17, conversation 'Lab Provider' (2 messages), no Library files, so no Library text is sent. Provider: the one configured (key from the environment or the app's saved key), through the capped proxy.

methods.seedChats: fixture: UiLab.seedChats writes the conversations, and with files a synthetic Library it then indexes, to the test profile's database
methods.refreshChats: store-call: ChatStore.refresh (what the app does on start)
methods.selectChat: store-call: ChatStore.selectChat (what picking a conversation in the side panel does)
methods.sendChatMessage: store-call: ChatStore.sendMessage (what the composer's Send does)

steps.text: Reply with the single word: ready.
steps.label: short provider turn
